name: ZoomCaargo Logistics
subtitle: Time-Critical Air Freight & Import Customs Clearance
campaign: Trade Lane Acquisition & B2B Freight Leads
challenge: Acquire high-intent commercial importers, freight forwarders, and enterprise manufacturers needing urgent customs air cargo clearance across China-India and Hong Kong-India trade lanes, while maintaining predictable CPL.
approach: Harvested high-intent transactional search queries for air cargo weight brackets (100kg+, 500kg+, 1000kg+) across specific trade corridors.
Engineered trade-lane specific landing pages highlighting flight schedule cut-offs and express customs clearance turnaround guarantees.
Deployed Meta remarketing ads targeting logistics managers, import-export business owners, and trade show participants.
Integrated dynamic phone call tracking and instant inquiry webhooks to alert dispatchers within 60 seconds of form submission.
result: Generated 9.55K search impressions with an outstanding 11.39% Click-Through Rate (CTR), acquiring 284 enterprise commercial importers with verified trade lane bookings.

strategies.title: 01 TRADE LANE SEARCH ARCHITECTURE
strategies.description: Constructed dedicated ad groups for key air trade corridors ('China to India air freight', 'Hong Kong urgent customs clearance', 'air cargo consolidation').

strategies.title: 02 11.39% CTR AD COPY TESTING
strategies.description: Tested clear transit timelines ('48-72 Hour Express Air Freight') and transparent weight rate bands to achieve an industry-beating 11.39% CTR.

strategies.title: 03 AD GROUP LEVEL CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION
strategies.description: Audited individual search queries to allocate budget directly into highest-converting trade lanes while filtering low-margin exploratory searches.

strategies.title: 04 RAPID INQUIRY RESPONSE PIPELINE
strategies.description: Connected web quote forms directly to WhatsApp and dispatch CRM, decreasing lead response time from hours to under 2 minutes.

keyLearnings: Corridor-specific headlines ('China to Mumbai Air Freight in 48 Hrs') produced nearly 3x higher CTR than generic air cargo copy.
Adding transparent rate bands directly in ad text filtered out small personal parcel senders, leaving high-value enterprise importers.
Speed to lead was critical: responding within 5 minutes increased freight booking conversion by 62%.
